protocol:
Western Blotting Protocol
Place cells in a microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge to collect the cell pellet.
Lyse the cell pellet with 100 µl of lysis buffer on ice for 30 min (For 1 X 106 cells, lyse with 100 µlof lysis buffer).
Centrifuge at 14,000 rpm (16,000 x g) for 10 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube and discard the pellet.
Remove 20 µl of supernatant and mix with 20 µl of 2x sample buffer.
Boil for 5 min.
Cool at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Microcentrifuge for 5 minutes.
Load up to 40 µl of sample to each well of a 1.5 mm thick gel.
Set gel running conditions according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Transfer the proteins to anitrocellulose or PVDF membrane with variable power settings according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Remove the blotted membrane from the transfer apparatus and immediately place in blocking buffer consisting of 5% nonfat dry milk/TBS-T. Incubate the blot for 1 hour at room temperature, or overnight at 4°C with agitation.
Dilute the primary antibody to the recommended concentration/dilution in 5% nonfat dry milk/TBS-T** (usually at 1µg/ml).
Place the membrane in the primary antibody solution and incubate for 2 hours at room temperature, or overnight at 4°C with agitation.
Wash  for 5 minutes with Wash Buffer (TBS containing 0.1% Tween-20).
[wash 1/3].
Wash  for 5 minutes with Wash Buffer (TBS containing 0.1% Tween-20).
[wash 2/3].
Wash  for 5 minutes with Wash Buffer (TBS containing 0.1% Tween-20).
[wash 3/3].
Incubate the membrane for 30 minutes at room temperature with horseradish peroxidase (HRP)‐conjugated secondary antibody, diluted to 1:1000 in 5% nonfat dry milk/TBS‐T.
Wash for 10 minutes with TBS containing 0.1% Tween‐20.
(1/4).
Wash for 10 minutes with TBS containing 0.1% Tween‐20.
(2/4).
Wash for 10 minutes with TBS containing 0.1% Tween‐20.
(3/4).
Wash for 10 minutes with TBS containing 0.1% Tween‐20.
(4/4).
Wash once for 2 minutes with PBS.
Incubate membrane (protein side up) with 10 ml of ECL (enhanced chemiluminescence substrate) for 1-2 minutes.
The final volume required is 0.125 ml/cm2.
Drain off the excess detection reagent, wrap up the blots, and gently smooth out any air bubbles.
Place the wrapped blots, protein side up, in an X-ray film cassette and expose to x-ray film.
Exposures can vary from 5 seconds to 60 minutes.

parameters.reagent: membrane (protein side up) with ECL substrate

# Lab Automation Script
# Generated from protocol analysis


### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
centrifuge(container='microcentrifuge tube', purpose='collect cell pellet')
lyse(container='microcentrifuge tube', reagent='lysis buffer', volume='100 µl', temperature='on ice', duration='30 min', cell_count='1 x 10^6 cells')
centrifuge(container='microcentrifuge tube', temperature='4°C', duration='10 min', speed='14,000 rpm (16,000 x g)')
transfer(container='new tube', reagent='supernatant', discard='pellet')
remove(reagent='supernatant', volume='20 µl')
mix(reagent='2x sample buffer', volume='20 µl', with='20 µl supernatant')
boil(temperature='boiling', duration='5 min')
cool(temperature='room temperature', duration='5 min')
centrifuge(duration='5 min')
load(container='gel (1.5 mm thick)', reagent='sample', volume='up to 40 µl', each well=True)
set(container='gel apparatus', running conditions='manufacturer’s instructions')
transfer(container='nitrocellulose or PVDF membrane', reagent='proteins', speed='variable power settings', according_to='manufacturer’s instructions')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: remove (container: transfer apparatus, reagent: blotted membrane)

### AUTOMATED SECTION ###
place(container='blocking buffer', reagent='blotted membrane', buffer composition='5% nonfat dry milk/TBS-T')
incubate(reagent='blot in blocking buffer', temperature='room temperature or 4°C', duration='1 hour or overnight', speed='with agitation')
dilute(reagent='primary antibody', diluent='5% nonfat dry milk/TBS-T', concentration='1 µg/ml (usually)')
place(container='primary antibody solution', reagent='membrane')
incubate(reagent='membrane in primary antibody solution', temperature='room temperature or 4°C', duration='2 hours or overnight', speed='with agitation')
wash(reagent='Wash Buffer (TBS containing 0.1% Tween-20)', duration='5 min', repeat='3 times')
incubate(reagent='membrane with HRP-conjugated secondary antibody', temperature='room temperature', duration='30 min', antibody dilution='1:1000 in 5% nonfat dry milk/TBS-T')
wash(reagent='TBS containing 0.1% Tween-20', duration='10 min', repeat='4 times')
wash(reagent='PBS', duration='2 min', repeat='once')
incubate(reagent='membrane (protein side up) with ECL substrate', volume='10 ml', duration='1-2 min', final volume required='0.125 ml/cm2')

### MANUAL SECTION ###
# MANUAL: drain (reagent: excess detection reagent)
# MANUAL: wrap (reagent: blots, other: {'smooth out air bubbles': True})
# MANUAL: place (container: X-ray film cassette, reagent: wrapped blots (protein side up))
# MANUAL: expose (container: X-ray film cassette, reagent: x-ray film, duration: 5 seconds to 60 minutes)
